title: Report context deficits instead of silent truncation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Mandatory blockers must not disappear when the prompt budget is tight. Success is a deficit report with unresolved gaps named. Related observation chain: `fangore_context_observation_chain`.
implementation:
`ContextCompiler` builds a versioned `ContextManifest` with token estimates and unresolved gaps. Working context is ephemeral; obligations stay in authoritative stores.

Covers: CTX-05.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
